::: {.proto-v v="A"}

Status
: [In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

What it is
: The BigPicture data repository, where slides and their metadata are stored. It receives submissions, keeps the data secure, and gives approved users their downloads. It is built on the Sensitive Data Archive (SDA).

Who it's for
: Data contributors, who submit and store data, and data users, who download what they are approved for.

Provided by
: NBIS

Before you start
: - An [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login with [Perun](perun.qmd) membership.
  - To contribute: be a consortium member or have a contributing-partner (SCTP) agreement.
  - To download: an approved application in [REMS](rems.qmd).

How to get access
: Get your upload or download credentials at [login.bp.nbis.se](https://login.bp.nbis.se/). Then follow the [Submission manual](../datasets/submission/index.qmd) or the [Download guide](../datasets/download/downloading-data.qmd).

Guides
: - [Submission manual (clinical)](../datasets/submission/index.qmd)
  - [Download guide](../datasets/download/downloading-data.qmd)

Terms and privacy
: Data Submission Guideline and Data Sharing Agreement [(SharePoint, members)]{.text-muted} · [BigPicture privacy notice](https://bigpicture.eu/bigpicture-privacy-notice)

Support
: ::: {.proto-support provider="NBIS" owner="[Name], NBIS" second="NBIS operations team" hours="best effort"}
  :::

Related services
: [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd), [Perun](perun.qmd), [REMS](rems.qmd), [Discovery](discovery.qmd), [Landing pages](landing-pages.qmd), [Grafana](grafana.qmd)

Source code
: [neic-sda](https://github.com/neicnordic/neic-sda), [sda-cli](https://github.com/NBISweden/sda-cli)

## Before you start

- An [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login with [Perun](perun.qmd) membership.
- To contribute: be a consortium member or have a contributing-partner (SCTP) agreement.
- To download: an approved application in [REMS](rems.qmd).

## How to get access

Get your upload or download credentials at [login.bp.nbis.se](https://login.bp.nbis.se/), then use [sda-cli](https://github.com/NBISweden/sda-cli):

- Contributing: the [Submission manual](../datasets/submission/index.qmd), which starts with a test upload.
- Downloading: the [Download guide](../datasets/download/downloading-data.qmd).

Coming later: Dataset on Demand, where a selection you make in [Discovery](discovery.qmd) is packaged as a new dataset you can apply for.

Every BigPicture slide lives in the Repository. You upload to it as a contributor and download from it once your access is approved.

::: {.proto-tasks}
::: {}
#### Upload data
Get credentials, test, then submit. [Submission manual](../datasets/submission/index.qmd)
:::

::: {}
#### Download data
Approved in [REMS](rems.qmd)? [Download guide](../datasets/download/downloading-data.qmd)
:::

::: {}
#### See what's coming in
[Grafana](grafana.qmd) shows uploads and growth.
:::
:::

Credentials for both come from [login.bp.nbis.se](https://login.bp.nbis.se/), with your [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login.
